notes.title: Spark in the Dark – Demo Update & Road to Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We're excited to share a new update for the [b]Spark in the Dark[/b] demo, featuring new mechanics, improvements, and many fixes.

[b]This is the final major update for the demo. The next big step is the Early Access release, planned for Q1 2026.[/b]
In Early Access, all three Dungeon tiers will be available. Our team is currently focused on finishing the second and third tiers, along with refining the core game systems.

[h2]Spark in the Dark Update 0.017[/h2]
[h3]Save System[/h3]
Your progress is now saved when resting at a campfire. You can exit the game and return later to continue right where you left off.
If your hero dies permanently, the save file is deleted.

[h3]Revival in Monster Lairs[/h3]
After death, the hero now has a chance to wake up in a monster lair.
The system considers which monsters were nearby at the moment of death, as well as the distance and accessibility of their lairs.
The hero revives with injuries (the number depends on the difficulty level) and lies still. Monsters ignore him until he gets up — giving the player a chance to choose the right moment to escape.
It’s a small but meaningful second chance after death.

[h3]Dagger Throwing[/h3]
The hero can now throw daggers.
They bounce off hard surfaces, stick into wood, and stay lodged in enemies — you can recover them after a fight.
Initially available to the [b]Thief[/b] and [b]Warrior[/b], other classes can learn this skill by finding a skill book.

[h3]Ancient Shields and New Enhancements[/h3]
Ancient shields have been reworked and new types have been added with varying weight and durability.
Shields can now have the following enhancements:
[list]
[*] [b]Reinforced Base[/b] — extra protection
[*] [b]Sturdy Straps[/b] — resistance to knockback
[*] [b]Leather Padding[/b] — reduced stamina cost
[/list]
Some shields also feature a spike that deals small damage to monsters when they hit the shield — unless they attack with a weapon.

[h3]Spiders and Webs[/h3]
Sometimes, after a spider dies, you may find that its abdomen has burst open — and small spiderlings have crawled out.
Also, stepping into active webs now not only slows the hero but attracts nearby spiders.

[h3]Campfire Nightmares[/h3]
If the hero has absorbed too much Darkness in the Dungeon, nightmares may appear during rest.
Drinking by the fire can reduce the chance of nightmares — but drinking too much may cause a hangover.
New hero voice lines at the campfire have also been added.

[h3]Armor Repair and Equipment Wear[/h3]
[list]
[*] Armor repair benches have been added and can be used outside of camp.
[*] Weapons can now break permanently if not repaired in time.
[*] Crossbows wear down with use and can be repaired just like lanterns.
[/list]
[h3]Storage and Inventory[/h3]
You can now store items in containers located in safe zones.
The system respects item size and container capacity.

[h3]Controls and Gamepad Support[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added key rebinding support for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Added visual layouts for PS4 DualShock, PS5 DualSense, Xbox, and generic gamepads.
[*] Fixed an issue with camera stick controls on gamepads.
[/list]
[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added item stat icons instead of text.
[*] Added a new "Keys" category to the inventory.
[*] Updated skill book illustrations.
[*] Added a list of key story events to your run statistics.
[*] Various other UI fixes and improvements.
[/list]
[h3]Also included:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dynamic chest content display
[*] Hero fatigue animations
[*] [b]Fixes and polish based on your feedback[/b]
[/list]
[b]Localization Update:[/b]
Spark in the Dark is now available in [b]Chinese, Hungarian, and Czech[/b]!

[b]Thank you for supporting the project and following the development![/b] 💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark – Development Update & New Demo
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

[b]We’d like to share some updates on the development progress of the game.[/b]

Our main focus right now is on the development of the second and third tiers of the Dungeon. We are adding new locations, quests, and NPCs to bring our vision of the game to life.

[b]Once these tiers are completed, we plan to launch the game in Early Access. [/b]Based on our estimates, the game will offer around 20 hours of gameplay, as the second and third tiers are larger than the first one, which is currently available in the demo.

The progress on these tiers is 80-90% complete, but we may release one more demo update before Early Access to test all the mechanics.

[b]While we continue working on the new tiers, we have decided to release an update for the demo. It includes improvements to the first tier, as well as some gameplay adjustments.[/b]

[h3]Spark in the Dark Update 0.016[/h3]
[b]Key changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded locations in the first tier – new areas have been added, and some existing ones have been reworked to better fit the game’s lore and atmosphere.
[*] The Depth Tower has been built – an important location that will play a role in the future.
[*] NPC interaction added – now you can meet a character you can talk to.
[*] New books and notes added, along with new journal entries related to various events.
[*] New skill – hand-to-hand combat. You can now fight monsters without weapons. Armor type and quality affect damage output.
[*] Bandages added – they can be used to stop bleeding.
[*] Shields can now have enhancements.
[*] In the Nightmare Dungeon, areas tainted by darkness have appeared, capable of quickly consuming the hero without a lantern.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c31698795e2bf01a4b4f1d8e42492fdfd5677cfc.png[/img]

[b]Additionally:[/b]
[list]
[*] New sounds added and some existing ones improved.
[*] New ambient tracks added.
[*] Screen stun effect added when falling on the back.
[*] Improved effects for the Collider and the Ancient Warrior Statue activation.
[*] Two new achievements added.
[*] Weapon generation in treasure hoard now considers the hero’s weapon skills.
[*] Some weapons and armor may now be initially damaged.
[*] [b]Updated some localizations and added missed strings.[/b]
[/list]
Numerous small fixes and improvements have also been made.

[b]We appreciate your feedback, ideas, and suggestions. Thank you for following the development and supporting the project![/b]

Wishing you thrilling adventures in the darkness of Dargroth! 💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark / New Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since the last update, we've made various improvements and innovations in Spark in the Dark. 
Most of the work is being done on the deep levels of Dargroth, but it's time to share our development progress with you, so we're pleased to present the Spark in the Dark (0.015) update.

[h3]Monster Improvements[/h3]
We've enhanced the behavior and abilities of nearly all monsters. Now, battles with them are more dynamic.
For example, Nisses and spiders can jump, and Morroch can make a powerful attack that closes the distance to the hero.
The creatures' intelligence and the accuracy of their attacks have also been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/0e02833462b964c9b6dc95e8d61f9798e59e0b58.gif[/img]

[b]You can now encounter bats in some areas of the Dungeon.[/b]
This involves a [i]Will[/i] check for the hero, and if the hero fails, he will be affected by [i]Fright[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/9e53e7b59a4641976f2932051e77ed74d1e29f71.gif[/img]

[h3]Ancient Armor Updated[/h3]
Their variety has increased, and they are now better designed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/dadb458763bd9327caff137ac06dc35af47fbef2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added durability display for damageable items.
[*] Now all hero classes can repair equipment, not just the Blacksmith as before.
[*] All shields (except solid-metal ones) can now be irreparably destroyed in battle when their durability drops to 0.
[/list]

[h3]New Blacksmith Skill - "Armor Improvement"[/h3]
To use this skill, you need to find elements like Steel, Chainmail Fragments, Leather, and Fabric.
Using these elements, you can enhance existing reinforcements on armor and add new ones.

Initially, the Blacksmith has knowledge of only a few enhancements like "Movable Plates" which are related to heavy and medium armor. However, during the game, he can find other enhancement schemes.

[h3]Interactions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some doors may be jammed and will require a crowbar to open.
[*] You can find [b]oilers[/b] in the Dungeon – they help open complex locks and jammed doors using the crowbar.
[*] The success of using the crowbar now takes into account the hero's Strength.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/f09fca104e8b4d4f82a1ae12d3c838e1581578a3.png[/img]

Stuck items (for example, an axe in the wall) require a Strength check to pull them out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/b03df4d4331976c2629b4fe7176ccf5821c74222.png[/img]

Some locations have been updated, graphics improved, and some materials updated.
New interior elements have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/5aef07a916a78791969d8593f91db35ac44e5c9d.png[/img]

[b]Gamepad Support Improvement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gamepad support from the main game menu.
[*] Added vibrations when taking damage.
[*] Interface button/action designation depending on the type of device.
[*] Added lighting on Sony gamepads in the color of the lantern and the campfire at the rest point.
[/list]

[b]ALSO:[/b]
[list]
[*] New and updated books, notes, and wall plaque texts for better lore alignment.
[*] New hero lines for various events and situations.
A subsystem for hero's curses has been added. Each class has its set of strong words, as well as common ones.
[*] Added new sounds and improved some existing ones.
[*] Bell activation.
[*] Improved item generation in containers.
[*] [b]Improved monster generation on hard difficulty.[/b]
No more blood spiders in the first room :) The population of creatures increases proportionally to the original Dungeon design.
[*] The hero removes heavy armor elements at the campfire (plate gloves, pauldrons).
[*] Updated some parts of the UI.
[*] Added 4 new achievements.
[/list]

[b]A number of smaller improvements and fixes have also been made, based on your feedback.
Thanks for the ideas and support!

We know you are eagerly awaiting the game, and we are doing everything we can to release it as soon as possible. However, everything needs to be done right, and there are still many exciting things ahead.[/b]

We wish you exciting adventures in the darkness of Dargroth!💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark / New Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since our last update, we've made various improvements to the Dargroth dungeon. 
We want to share our development progress with you, so we're glad to introduce the Spark in the Dark update (0.014).

[h3]Hero's Name[/h3]
We've added a name for the hero, which is set at the start of the game. The name is used in-game and also displayed in the history of the best heroes. 
Updated the character selection and dungeon difficulty level screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/2096d13cb83768022824980f6076e2f1ec6349e6.png[/img]

Based on the outcomes of their adventure, a hero can receive a title, such as [i]Master of Secret Paths[/i] or [i]Monster Slayer[/i]. 

Updated and expanded the passage history in the list of the best heroes. 

[b]Added a description of skills in the character window.[/b]

[h3]Combat Improvements[/h3]
We've added side dodges for the hero and updated the back jump.

Introduced the ability [i]"Counter attack"[/i] for the Warrior class. They can deliver a powerful blow after receiving an attack in block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/dab38203cb6bd456917d38ad96a2eb87afd1ba59.gif[/img]

Improved shield combat and block. Added new hero reactions when receiving a strong attack in block.

[b]Combat sounds have been refined and updated.[/b]

[h3]Crossbow Enhancements[/h3]
Added a quiver. Now you can see how many arrows you have left in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/79190daa1d667e0b82e5f24e4eb6b46c804d9736.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Hunters and thieves can find the skill book [i]"Shadow Shooter"[/i] which grants the skill to shoot with lethal efficiency from a concealed state.
[*] Improved crossbow firing. Broadened the firing angle for hitting enemies above and below. [*] Updated inventory arrow images.
[/list]
[h3]Creature Population[/h3]
[b]Now in the dungeon, you can encounter little spiders. They dwell in places where spider eggs are laid. A spider can be easily crushed, but sometimes they are poisonous.[/b]

Improved centipede generation. Now they can appear in many different places. 
Spiders and centipedes can also be found in crevices.

Sometimes you can encounter powerful Undeads – they are bulkier than usual and possess greater strength. Their number depends on the difficulty level of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/baccf8e6fee5caca87f681d3bfd16e3c5ae1912d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Some locations and environmental objects have been updated.[/b] 
[*] Improved activation of the Astral Collider and the statue of the Ancient Warrior. 
[*] Added hero's lines in some locations.
[/list]
[b]Technical improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Most localizations have been updated and supplemented.
[*] Added another level of camera zoom.
[*] Added an option "Disable chromatic aberration" in the game settings.
[*] Minor improvements in gamepad support. The interface now displays correct button names depending on the device.
[/list]
Alongside these, many more minor improvements and fixes have been made, including based on your feedback. 
Thank you for your ideas and support!

 We wish you thrilling adventures in the darkness of Dargroth!💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark / New Demo
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Since the last update, we've made many of various innovations and improvements in the Spark in the Dark dungeon.
The time has come to release the updated Spark in the Dark demo (0.013).

Here are the key changes you can expect in this update:

[h3]Hero's Journal[/h3]
Now, the hero can make journal entries during a rest.
Journal entries reflect what has happened to the hero. They take into account battles with monsters, injuries received, visits to various locations, finding artifacts, etc. Each playthrough results in a unique journal.
Quest elements are highlighted in the journal and are then marked as completed after being fulfilled.
The journal will continue to evolve in the future, covering more and more events and situations.

[b]A system for tracking the number of days the hero has spent in the dungeon has also been introduced. The current day is displayed in the hero's window, as well as on the death and level completion screens.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/57856ee74084524c12a0f364ffd5c4ead4fb0c90.png[/img]

[h3]Armor Update[/h3]
We have revamped and improved almost all the armors in the game, as well as created new ones. The armors are now more intricately detailed and realistic. We have also enhanced the lore aspect, and the armors now come with updated descriptions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/8056be79e86d2034254b103814b2a57b17bb29a0.png[/img]

[h3]Talismans and Amulets[/h3]
You will be able to find talismans and amulets in the Dungeon. Besides increasing various characteristics, they can also impact some of the hero's abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/0613242e466c16493b135a0aae8ff907089f2f4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/7d9f96587114859468f93b230e3ad33f94ea7985.png[/img]

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
Added new hammers and axes, as well as some other weapons. Previously, their variety was minimal, now it's better :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/4bb5cf1e3a9625583ce3122c08b3d4429e64d9f3.png[/img]

[b]Added unique weapons of the Ancients, as well as updated some existing weapons.[/b]

[h3]New Locations and Interactions[/h3]
Despite the current focus of Dungeon construction on floors 2 and 3, we occasionally make improvements to floor 1 of Dargrot. We have added several new locations and interactions, as well as selectively updated some existing ones.

Added new secret places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/72fc4ba0601d9ad50ef9313602fd86df0a62da12.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/4434b81a35ac8cd2a2555f7ce89218877e93dde0.png[/img]

[h3]Effect Indicators[/h3]
Temporary effects on the hero (buffs/debuffs) are now displayed at the bottom of the main screen. This way, it's easy to see how much time is left for a particular effect—be it poison, bleeding, or an elixir effect—and there's no need to constantly press TAB to check it.

[b]Added the "Secret Traps" skill book[/b] that the Thief can find and study. This allows them to disarm traps in chests. The variety of traps found on chests will be increased.

[b]The flying creature has received updated behavior and can now be shot down with a crossbow.[/b]

[b]ALSO:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved procedural item generation
[*] Added new sounds
[*] New hero lines
[*] New and updated books and notes
[*] New achievements
[/list]

Additionally, numerous smaller improvements and fixes have been made along the way, taking into account your feedback.

Thank you all for your feedback, ideas, and support!

Wish you exciting adventures in the Dungeon! 💀

notes.title: Devlog – New features and improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here we have gathered the main improvements we have made in the Dargroth Dungeon over the past few months.

[b]These enhancements (along with some others currently in progress) will be available in the Spark in the Dark demo update, which we plan to release in September.[/b]

[h3]Armor Update[/h3]
We have revamped and improved almost all the armors in the game, as well as created new ones. The armors are now more intricately detailed and realistic. We have also enhanced the lore aspect, and the armors now come with updated descriptions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/8056be79e86d2034254b103814b2a57b17bb29a0.png[/img]

[*]Several new hero phrases have been added.

[*] [b]Added Turkish translation and updated existing localizations.[/b]
[*] Added 2 new achievements.
[*] Several new sounds have been added.

Wish you exciting adventures in the Dungeon! 💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark / New Demo
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Over the past few months, we have made many different improvements and innovations to Spark in the Dark. And now we want to share with you a fresh demo.

New features and improvements are waiting for you.

[h3]Dream catchers[/h3]
You can find rare artifacts called Dreamcatchers in the Dungeon. Having such an artifact, your hero, in case of death, is reborn at the place of the last rest, and the stone disappears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/48512d54a16fc3f9d1dbfa08a061087a1f0789b6.png[/img]

This will increase the survivability of the hero, and protect against accidental deaths a bit), at the same time, it will keep the game hardcore, because the number of "lives" is limited.

The number of such stones in the Dungeon depends on the complexity of the game. There are 5 on initial difficulty, 3 on standard, and 1 on nightmare.

[h3]Skill Books[/h3]
In the Dungeon, you can find special rare books, reading which gives the hero a new skill / ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/a9d43c59a9cbbde781e7aa557e5239af731357b7.png[/img]

You can find books that give the ability to improve sharpening or poisoning weapons. A thief can find a book on setting up poison traps and learn how to disarm them. The number of books will increase.

[h3]Weapon[/h3]
We have made various improvements to the game related to weapons and the combat system.

[b]Added new weapons.[/b] 
Legacy weapons are better balanced, descriptions have been updated to better match the lore.
Updated all weapon and shield images to better quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/4e49154bf9e32dfeebbf799879abbb0990c61f77.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/34267d253a08b8a22976973ea00feff935a3f6ad.png[/img]

Improved weapon generation system on levels. For example, in each raid, a different sword may be lying in the same place (or not lying).

Added "One-Handed Weapon" and "Two-Handed Weapon" skills. They are growing when using the corresponding type of weapon.

[list]
[*] Added the ability to poison arrows.
[*] Added sounds when arrows hit wood, stone, metal, monsters.
[*] The crossbow can be worn simultaneously with two-handed weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/2f41e8d05bdf91f02de0fa011e0345618cb192b4.png[/img]

[b]Added new animations and abilities to the monsters.[/b]
Spiders can now effectively bite the victim, the undead can kick, and Morroch can deliver a powerful kick from which the hero will fall on his back.

Improvements in the artificial intelligence of monsters.

[b]Updated some locations and environments.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/3f92abaa128260c3cfa2b0f4cadce2928076f295.jpg[/img]

[h3]New sounds[/h3]
Added a set of new sounds that were previously missing :)

For example, now you will hear how the lamps light up and break, how the crowbar creaks when the chest is opened, and how the hero screams when he falls into the abyss.
And also, those terrible voices in the head, which the adept of the Four Towers, who stabbed himself in madness, wrote about in his diary!

[h3]Interface Improvements[/h3]
Updated some windows and dialogs. When viewing equipment, a "live" character is now displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/ffce2df061bba151646b7dc4ccae40bf4f3517dc.png[/img]

A new book about Starstones has been added.

[b]Added French translation. Bienvenue au Donjon ![/b]

[b]Added partly support of gamepads.[/b]

A lot of improvements, fixes, improvements, balancing, including those based on your feedback.

Thank you for your feedback, we really appreciate it!
Wish you interesting adventures in the Dungeon! 💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark / Demo updated
notes.content:
We are continuing to work on the deeper levels of the Dungeon. At the same time we'd like to share the fresh demo with you. The update contains various improvements of the Dungeon and gameplay described below.

Thank you for your feedback, we really appreciate it and it helps us develop the game and better understand you guys!
Sometimes we cannot do everything quickly because we are a small indie team but we listen to many of your ideas and suggestions! 💀

[h3]Statistics and achievements[/h3]

Now in the hero window you can see statistics and achievements for the current game. Previously, this information was only on the final screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c2c1637652000c7054bfee3af7e2912083531e60.png[/img]

If you find all the secret locations, this will also show up as a corresponding achievement, although until then the total number of secret locations in the level will remain unknown.

Obtaining the achievement will notify you that all secret locations have been found.
The same applies to books - the finding of all unique books on the level is now recorded as an achievement.

[h3]Light and night vision of monsters[/h3]

When the hero is in the light or with the lantern on, the monsters see him with 100% vision. However, when the hero is in the dark, the monster's range of vision decreases depending on how well it sees in the dark. All monsters have different vision in the dark.

The bestiary displays information about the vision of the monsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/5d8e000117f955259c4094e2bf12dd99a0fd9bdc.png[/img]

[h3]Heroes have a new skill Shields[/h3]

It determines the effectiveness of using shields in fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c32a0988f8afb6198fbff87b6d39ba9fabf973c8.png[/img]

For example, the Warrior has initially Shields skill = 3 and the Thief has initially Shields skill = 1.
If the Thief takes the shield and the enemy hits him with a powerful two-handed, all stamina can be taken from one blow, and the block will be knocked out in this way. But the Warrior will be able to withstand several such blows.

The skill is level up as the shields are used.

Also, weapon blocks have been improved. Removal of stamina depends on the level of possession of the weapon with which the hero is defending.
When hit in the block, the skill of the weapon is slightly increased.

[h3]Improved the system of receiving injuries[/h3]

Now, getting injuries depends on the type of armor:

[list]
[*] For heavy armor, injuries are only obtained on a critical hit.
[*] For medium armor, injuries are obtained with a critical hit and a 50/50 chance for a normal hit.
[*] For light armor, injuries are obtained with a critical hit and a normal hit (this was the case for all armor before).
[*] Without armor, injuries are obtained with any hit.
[/list]
If the weapon is poisoned, the poison is always applied on a critical and normal hit, regardless of the type of armor.

[h3]AND:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added broken swords.
[*] Improved Ancient Altar.
[*] Some armor can enhance a hero's Constitution.
[*] Different color of the blood of monsters. The weapon is dyed upon hitting the victim's corresponding color.
[*] Added new animations for crowbar and Ripper skill, improved some of the previous hero animations.
[*] The hero can carry as many lanterns and crowbars as he wants, limiting himself only to the maximum carried weight.
[*] The hero has new, more authentic underpants)
[*] Improved the mechanics of climbing and rappelling, various level improvements.
[*] Numerous minor improvements and bug fixes.
[*] Optimization, reduced peak processor loads.
[*] [b]Improved English localization[/b]
[*] [b]Added Portuguese[/b]
[/list]

Thank you!

P.S. The keys rebinding settings are in progress and it will be added to the game by the near patches. It will allow people to play the game with AZERTY keyboards. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Devlog – New features & improvements
notes.content:
[h3]Achievements[/h3]

We implemented a system of achievements. So far, 10 ones have been done, in the future there will be more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/abc248e720a94b2431640e051d12399397fac787.png[/img]

[h3]New hero skills and features[/h3]

The blacksmith received the [b]Equipment repair[/b] skill. This allows him to repair armor while on the rest if he finds the right tools. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/db36a724a8c4b3e4fd8ba67d40a35cd7a235bd6c.png[/img]

The warrior received the [b]Battle Fury[/b] passive. When killing a monster, it temporarily increases [i]Will[/i], providing increased health and stamina regeneration. In this case, the effect increases with each defeated enemy. 

The thief received the [b]Weapon Poisoner[/b] passive, which allows him to more effectively inflict poisons on weapons. 

[h3]Poison system[/h3]

You can find poisons in the Dungeon, apply them to weapons and poison monsters in battle. Some monsters can poison the hero. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/9aee4a5421cb668c47bca7658fb881d71fd26965.png[/img]

[h3]New and improved interactions [/h3]

Refined many interactions with the environment and added new ones.
Picking locks with picks or crowbars is accompanied by animations.
The exploring of manholes has been updated, animations for falling into the abyss have been added, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/2d5510ae4a5d4370384ac63ed342f7e7bc855d9f.png[/img]

[h3]Increasing realism [/h3]

Implemented a system of item weight. Most of the items in the game have weights. Also, the hero has an indicator of the maximum carrying weight. It depends on [i]Constitution[/i]. Overloading is possible, but it reduces mobility, affects the exploring of manholes, descent on the rope, and causes a more rapid onset of fatigue.

Many small but important mechanics, for example, [i]Strength[/i] affects the speed of combat with two-handed weapons. Fatigue reduces the hero's mobility. If you light a lantern in a room, monsters nearby will notice it. 

Improved combat and monster behavior. 

[h3]New blood system [/h3]

When you hit the monster, blood flies out of it and splashes the environment.
The size of the bloody spray determines the type of weapon - from blows with a two-handed weapon, splashes are more powerful, swords and axes shed more blood than hammers. It also affects the degree of damage - light, normal or critical. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/b1687a9b3ddfde34b9c2b76ed7bba49e35a5591c.png[/img]

[h3]New decorations / improved locations [/h3]

We are now actively working on the deeper tiers of the Dungeon. But do not forget to update the already existing levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/425f219a92084442722fad2a8492fadbe59c1bd0.png[/img]

Scolopendra can sometimes be encountered (this is randomized like many events in the Dungeon) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c60b94bdabfba08cc5a80ff68be163c13db290c4.png[/img]

[h3]New traps [/h3]

The Dungeon contains new traps that strike with poisonous gas and deadly thorns. 

[b] ALSO:[/b]

[list]
[*] Lore updated, new books added.
[*] The interface has been updated.
[*] Procedural generation has been improved. Balance corrected.
[*] Keys to safes are procedurally generated, if there are valuables.
[*] Updated some weapons and shields. 
[/list]

Our small team is constantly working on the Dungeon. Stay with us!
